briefs_summary.policy: The canonical build seed changes when brief references change; receipt and custom provenance metadata may change. Actual slide XML/resources are compared independently.
briefs_summary.actual_package_part_changes_explanation: Current comparison also includes final49copy repair; ppt/presentation.xml section GUIDs follow canonical seed. Intermediate brief-only comparison had only ppt/presentation.xml change.

briefs.intentional_update: Corrected stale rationale to match the accepted three option headers and one full-width six-dimension common lens.

media_summary.policy: Retained source media and actually emitted media are separate claims; transformed/cropped or approved WMDS replacements require semantic disposition.

cleanup_carry.scope: Removed two unused local definitions and unused registered assets; folded actual case asset paths; formatted YAML only. No visible copy, geometry, authored notes, hidden states or section membership changed.

visual_comparison_policy: Native slide XML and active layout/master/media relationship closures are compared by decompressed bytes, resolving target names to content. Notes are audited separately. The master sldLayoutIdLst and inactive master-to-layout relationships are omitted because they only list unrelated page layouts; the implicit theme relationship ID is normalized because removing an inactive layout renumbers that ID. All active master drawing and theme content remains byte compared.
